description:
Current for-sale listings in the suburb, with address, price, beds/baths,
coordinates and an `off_market` flag per listing.

`total` is the full number on the market (computed before `limit`), so a
count is accurate even when the rows are capped. Raise `limit` for more
listings; set `verbose=true` for the agent's full description text; set
`off_market=true` for off-market listings only.

limit.description: Max listings to return (default 30, max 200). `total` always reports the full match count.

off_market.description: Only return OFF-MARKET listings: not on realestate.com.au or Domain, sourced from the agency's own site, and still believed live — the Microburbs property finder's 'Off market only' rule. Default false returns every listing, each carrying its own `off_market` flag. `total` counts the filtered set.

verbose.description: Include the agent's full ad-copy in `attributes.description`. Off by default — it averages ~1.5 KB per listing.

name: suburbs_listings_for_sale
title: Suburb · Current for-sale listings
